scope: Actual local production preview at http://127.0.0.1:3187. Protected management content uses explicitly labelled deterministic API fixtures; no live OAuth or private-service verification.

tests.keyboard: Client selection, exact review evidence, consent checkbox and approve/reject controls; visible focus and no observed trap.
tests.reducedMotion: Rendered routes have no active CSS animations with reduced motion requested.

representativeContrast.method: Browser-painted PNG backdrop with selected text hidden without layout changes; conservative brightest pixel across each text rectangle and gradient endpoints.

correctedIssues: Policy digest wraps instead of clipping at320px.
Heading gradient endpoint and small feature labels meet representative rendered contrast thresholds.
Focusable connection instructions have a named region role.
limits: Automated checks and representative browser-painted gradient samples do not establish complete WCAG conformance.
Manual screen-reader review, all dynamic/error/hover states, high-contrast modes, user text-spacing overrides and real authenticated management sessions were not audited.
Hosted OAuth, provider operations, native MCP clients and deployed mobile devices were not exercised.
